name: 43212 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43212 (Columbus) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 75 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43212 (Columbus) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43212 (Columbus) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 65 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
